fields.summary: Production Alert: checkout-api failure caused by resource_exhaustion
fields.description:
Service checkout-api reported critical errors. Root cause category is resource_exhaustion.
Trace:
File "app/checkout-api/handler.py", line 42, in process
Exception: resource_exhaustion exception occurred.

comments.body: Mitigated issue by restarting checkout-api and applying runbook RB-db-pool-exhaustion.
